# Phase 5 results: three operating points (generated by scripts/phase5_run.py)

Offline simulation (CPU-only burst-trace projection, integer ticks, free context switches). No kernel-level or hardware measurement. Frozen controllers only; nothing was trained or tuned in Phase 5.

Python 3.11.9; Phase 3 controller `ae9db57acecd`, Phase 4 controller `f4021560ce9c`; config `df6fa978e347`.

| operating point | processes / workload | workloads | total processes | total jobs | mean jobs / workload |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | 6 | 1000 | 6000 | 32326 | 32.3 |
| medium | 14 | 1000 | 14000 | 77567 | 77.6 |
| large | 22 | 1000 | 22000 | 121900 | 121.9 |

**Definitions.** *Geo change*: geometric mean over workloads of T_method / T_comparator, minus 1 (T = mean job turnaround of a workload; the pre-specified estimand). *Aggregate change*: mean(T_method) / mean(T_comparator) − 1, which weights long-running workloads more. Negative = lower turnaround. Test: paired sign-flip permutation; CIs: paired bootstrap (10,000). Supported = Holm p < 0.05 and CI upper bound < 0; practically meaningful additionally requires CI upper bound ≤ −1%; negligible = CI within ±1%.
